text: おとくな　けいじばんに　かいて　あったこと　まねして　かいて　みたの！

structure.jp: おとくな　けいじばんに
かいて　あったこと

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means to try doing it. かいてみた = 'tried writing'.

patterns.name: 〜てある
patterns.explanation: てある after a verb says something was done and the result is still there. かいてあった = 'was written'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a sentence is a soft, feminine or childlike way to explain. かいてみたの = 'I tried writing it, you see'.
